summary: Operator page (2026): $40 a night, $245 a week, $750 a month; 80 FHU 50A sites (60 pull-through); open all year; phone/email booking. Gates pass ($40, Google 4.6/329). Long-stay tests pass on imagery (many open pull-throughs); no engine to check nights.
flags: PRICE GATE (private): posted rate $40 a night (page copyright 2026, 'Currently priced at') - under $50, passes. Good Sam: directory says not a GS Park (stored false, derived); operator silent; military true (directory) left as stored. Gateway not needed.
PRESENCE: operator page on the dealership's site coachlightrv.com (confirmed this park: 5305 S Garrison Ave, 417-358-3666), Facebook page, Google 4.6 stars, 329 reviews.

LONG-STAY (weekly $245 and monthly $750 marketed, so the five tests were run): (1) nightly price posted - pass; (2) no booking engine, but a posted nightly price, phone, email and request form - pass; (3) marketed to travellers off I-49 with a dealership service shop next door - pass; (4) one-night occupancy check NOT POSSIBLE (no engine); Esri imagery (leaf-off) shows roughly 45 rigs on 80 sites with the north pull-through loop largely empty - room for nightly guests - pass on that evidence; (5) Google 4.6 stars on 329 reviews, a volume typical of a transient stop - pass. Not a long-stay drop.

Pin OK: stored 37.0951,-94.3141 is the park entrance off Garrison Ave (the operator's GPS 37.095084,-94.314075); the loops centre ~140 m SW near 37.0943,-94.3154. Under the threshold. Waterfront 'not waterfront' confirmed (no water).
